title: The AI data center boom is colliding with cities scarred by big industry | TechCrunch
summary: Data center companies and their customers are promising new jobs and economic growth, but that pitch hasn’t won over a majority of Americans who oppose data center construction in their area, often over environmental and energy concerns.
